bhajan.title: Amrutha Sai Naama Akhanda Sai Prema

discourse.excerpt: Give in reverence; give in plenty; give with modesty; give as to a friend; give without any thought of reward. Do not give ostentatiously.
discourse.theme: Give in reverence, in plenty, with modesty — and by the Name, keep God ever near.
discourse.title: God, Ever Near

reflection: Swami says to give in reverence, in plenty, with modesty — and that by the Name you can keep God ever near. Today, give one thing quietly, with no thought of reward, and let the Name rest on your tongue. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7, 21 Dec 1967)
seva_nudge: Give one thing today in reverence and in plenty — a meal, your time, a listening ear — with modesty and no thought of reward.
